title: trailer.config.json
description: A trailer: scenes in play order, each with what the narrator says, plus the look, the voice and the cuts. Generated by engine/scripts/gen-schema.mjs.

projectName.description: The project, as said and shown

tagline.description: One line under the name on the end card

repoUrl.description: Repository URL (shown without https:// unless link is set)

text.description: What the end card shows, e.g. github.com/you/project

link.description: The link on the end card

scene.description: Scene id to show it on (default the outro)

person.description: third (default): first-person copy is a lint error

aspect.description: The film's aspect (default 16:9); --aspect and cuts override it

targetSeconds.description: The length the film aims at (default 60)

fitSeconds.description: Trim pauses (never the voice) until the film is at most this long

theme.description: Look and motion of the film

app.description: Design tokens of the app, for recreated UI (font, mono, bg, surface, ink, muted, border, accent, good, bad, warn, radius)

captions.description: Karaoke captions; true / false or the settings

avoid.description: Keep captions clear of on-screen elements

music.description: The music: false for none, a path to a licensed track (relative to the config), or a synthesized bed

sfx.description: Sound effects: true, false or a volume (0 to 2)

voice.description: The narrator. Default: Deepgram aura-2-hermes-en at 1.0, falling back to macOS say, espeak-ng, then silence

sayVoice.description: macOS say voice for the fallback

forbiddenTerms.description: Words that warn when they appear anywhere in the copy

path.description: URL path for a live capture

image.description: A ready-made screenshot, relative to the config

scale.description: Device pixel ratio of the image (default 2)

dir.description: Static folder, relative to the project

serve.description: Serve a static folder for the capture

startCmd.description: Command that starts the app (run in capture.cwd)

cwd.description: Folder for startCmd, relative to the project

capture.description: Screens of the app, for screenshot and walkthrough scenes

scenes.description: Scene ids in play order (default: every scene)

overrides.description: Per scene id: fields deep-merged over that scene in this cut

captions.description: Karaoke captions; true / false or the settings

avoid.description: Keep captions clear of on-screen elements

additionalProperties.description: A shorter or differently shaped render from the same scenes

format.description: The film format chosen (e.g. courtroom, sports broadcast)

sources.description: Where each claim in the script comes from

meta.description: Notes for people and agents; not rendered

id.description: Unique id (defaults to the type); cuts, credit.scene and overrides refer to it

say.description: What the narrator says in this scene: a string, or a list of strings / { text, gap } (gap: frames before the line).

turn.description: The scene where the project is named: the music drums come in on the next bar

poster.description: Take the poster frame from this scene

loop.description: Last scene only: its final 12 frames fade into frame 0 (scene 1 settled), so the last frame matches the first and the film loops

firstFrame.description: Scene 1 only: "settled" shows its first cue already in place on frame 0 (the default for 9:16, 1:1 and looping films); "live" starts it empty

mood.description: A mood (blob: see BLOB_MOODS; open-peeps and notionists have their own sets)

x.description: Feet x in 16:9 frame px (mapped in 9:16 and 1:1 unless variants override it)
